nodes.html: An SMSF specialist handles fund setup, annual accounts, tax return lodgement, independent audit coordination, pension establishment, contribution management, and compliance with the SIS Act and ATO rules. With Division 296 now applying to balances above $3m and Payday Super rolling out, specialist oversight has never been more important. Our matched specialists stay across these changes so you do not have to.
nodes.text: An SMSF specialist handles fund setup, annual accounts, tax return lodgement, independent audit coordination, pension establishment, contribution management, and compliance with the SIS Act and ATO rules. With Division 296 now applying to balances above $3m and Payday Super rolling out, specialist oversight has never been more important. Our matched specialists stay across these changes so you do not have to.

nodes.html: From 1 July 2026, Division 296 applies an additional 15% tax (30% total) on earnings within an SMSF when a member's total super balance exceeds $3 million. If your fund is approaching or above this threshold, specialist advice on contribution strategy, pension structuring, and balance management is essential. Our network includes SMSF specialists who model Division 296 outcomes.

nodes.q: Do I need an accountant for my SMSF?
nodes.a: An SMSF must be audited annually by an independent approved auditor, and the annual return must be lodged by a registered agent. Most trustees use an SMSF specialist accountant to prepare accounts, coordinate the audit, and lodge the return. If your fund has property (LRBA) or balances near the $3m Division 296 threshold, specialist advice is strongly recommended.
nodes.aText: An SMSF must be audited annually by an independent approved auditor, and the annual return must be lodged by a registered agent. Most trustees use an SMSF specialist accountant to prepare accounts, coordinate the audit, and lodge the return. If your fund has property (LRBA) or balances near the $3m Division 296 threshold, specialist advice is strongly recommended.

nodes.q: How much does SMSF accounting cost?
nodes.a: Annual SMSF accounting and audit typically ranges from $1,500 to $3,500 depending on complexity — more if the fund holds property, has borrowings, or needs Division 296 modelling. The matched specialist will give you a clear quote after reviewing your fund. The matching service itself is free.

nodes.q: Can an SMSF accountant help with Division 296 planning?
nodes.a: Yes. From 1 July 2026 (the 2026–27 financial year onward), funds with member balances above $3 million face additional tax on earnings under Division 296. The matched specialist models the impact and advises on contribution timing, pension strategies and restructuring options.
nodes.aText: Yes. From 1 July 2026 (the 2026–27 financial year onward), funds with member balances above $3 million face additional tax on earnings under Division 296. The matched specialist models the impact and advises on contribution timing, pension strategies and restructuring options.

nodes.q: Can an SMSF accountant help with pension setup?
nodes.a: Yes. The matched specialist establishes retirement-phase pensions, advises on minimum drawdowns, and ensures the pension documentation and tax treatment are correct — so you maximise the tax-free earnings in retirement phase.
